sections.html: Some time ago Mastacembelus greshoffi could be imported from the Congo. It is a spiny eel reaching approximately 35 cm in length.
Mastacembelus greshoffi occurs over rocky bottoms in rivers and lakes, also in rapids.

The best food is meaty food, and they eat rather plenty of it. They like mosquito larvae, worms and also now and then a small fish. Therefore, tank mates that are not too small should be selected for their socialization in a community tank.

Spiny eels are intelligent fish and show a multiplicity of interesting behaviours. They can also become amazingly tame and then eat literally from the hand of their caregiver. A complete covering of the aquarium is important, since spiny eels rank among the "escapee kings" among aquarium fish.
With a little luck and smartness, breeding of this species should be possible; some relatives have already been bred successfully in aquaria.
